name: CoreCU
scope: SWGXR combat fork; pre-CU progression with CU-inspired balance and combat feel
progression: Preserve Core3 pre-CU profession trees, skill-specific XP, training prerequisites, skill-point budget, mixed-profession builds and certification progression. Advanced abilities remain provisional skeletons pending later design.
